highest_rule: A layout can be different from another layout and still be a poor LP. Non-clone is necessary but never sufficient.

review_order.name: Delivery Integrity Gate
checks: Confirm owner HTML SHA matches the exact HTML used to render review screenshots.
Confirm current and rejected-baseline provenance are independently frozen and not duplicated/contaminated.
Confirm referenced media files load in the owner bundle.

review_order.name: Blind Single-page Premium Gate
review_order.question: Without knowing variant IDs, research IDs or sibling pages: does this single page itself look intentionally art-directed and high-quality enough to advance to owner review?

review_order.name: Media Reality Gate
review_order.question: Are images unmistakably present as meaningful composition/storytelling, not merely technically present?

review_order.name: Benchmark Perceptual Fidelity Gate
review_order.metadata_allowed: research references only after blind note is locked
checks: Compare the screenshot with the visible qualities promised by the selected benchmark mechanism.
Require perceptual effect, not Pattern ID or DOM trace.

review_order.name: Rejected Baseline Delta Gate
checks: Compare current vs latest Shun-rejected 1440 and 390 side-by-side.
Judge macro silhouette, type relationship, media rhythm, density arc, material language, authored focal sequence and ending.
Added sections/classes do not count as sufficient change.

review_order.name: Mobile Independent Art-direction Gate
checks: Confirm media authority, type hierarchy, authored body moment and ending survive without generic stacking.

review_order.name: Cross-sample Template Risk Gate
checks: Only after absolute quality passes, compare same-Family and cross-Family siblings.
Detect template swap / shared public pixel grammar.

review_order.name: Trace / Technical Corroboration
review_order.rule: These can corroborate a visual PASS but can never rescue a visual RETURN.

hard_return_examples: images exist in HTML/ZIP but visually read as absent, incidental or decorative
page is structurally different from siblings but still looks generic or low-quality
current page looks materially close to the latest owner-rejected version
benchmark mechanism is documented but not visually recognizable
typography/spacing/media framing/material grammar are generic across supposedly distinct pages
only borders/cards/grid ratios/dark panels change while overall gestalt stays the same
desktop looks authored but 390 collapses to a generic stack
technical QA is Green but blind premium impression is poor
delivery artifact cannot prove current HTML and screenshot/baseline integrity
client_evidence_dependent_rule: Use only when truthful representation of a selected high-value mechanism genuinely requires client-owned staff/store/results/pricing/credentials evidence. Do not use it to excuse weak art direction that can be created safely with illustrative media.
batch_rule: For Stage A quality validation, a sample that fails Stage 1 or Stage 2 blocks batch Human Reality PASS until corrected.
